extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: two-section articulated tram on a short street track piece, approx. 20.7 x 2.4 x 5.2 m (L x W x H incl. raised pantograph; car body height 3.5 m above rail), wheel diameter 0.68 m, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front faces -Y; both ends have a driver's cab; doors (coral, closed) on the right-hand side; the pantograph arms (tram_pantograph_arms) are a separate object with origin on the hinge of the fixed base frame (tram_pantograph_base) - rotate around local X (glTF X) by about -30 deg to lower them onto the roof; 12 wheels on 3 bogies (one Jacobs bogie under the articulation) are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); the track embedded in paving (tram_track) is a separate object, rail top at 0.30 m; neutral glowing destination displays without text or line number; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
